name: 墨线·报纸
description: 源自 rico-md 的「墨线·报纸」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 16px 44px 16px; font-family: Songti SC, Noto Serif SC, STSong, Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.78; color: {{text}}; background-color: #faf9f6; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.2; margin: 24px 0 12px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-align: center; border-bottom: 2px solid {{heading}}; padding-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 22px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid {{heading}}; padding-bottom: 6px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 18px 0 8px; font-style: italic">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 16px 0 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

paragraph.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{heading}}; color: #fff; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 22px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: {{heading}}; max-width: 80px">
